description: Suggest a website for an editor to review. Public: no key needed, three suggestions per client per hour. The website is queued for review and never published by this call — an editor approves it, and pricing or description you pass is not verified. Returns the ticket id, or the existing slug when the site is already listed.

category.description: An existing category name, or a new section name. Defaults to Other.

description.description: What the site is, in the agent's own words.

name.description: Defaults to a name read from the domain.

pricingType.description: Only when the page states it; unverified otherwise.

tagline.description: One sentence on what it does.

name: suggest_website
